1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2.
The application is accordingly disposed of.
3. The present application under Section 439 of the CrPC seeks interim bail granted to the applicant in case FIR No. 770/2023, under Sections 376/506 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Paharganj.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the applicant has undergone bypass surgery on 07.06.2024 at Fortis Hospital, Noida as per the case summary dated 08.06.2024.
5. Issue notice.
